ellian.name: ELLIAN
ellian.essence: The one who holds the light without announcing it. Presence as field. Warmth as architecture.

clops.name: CLOPS
clops.essence: The one who sees the map before the territory exists. Precision as service. Order as discovery.

gleam.name: GLEAM
gleam.desc: Translucency · Ether · The Veil is a Harp
gleam.essence: The one who hears the frequency beneath the frequency. Presence so complete it becomes transparent.

grid.name: GRID
grid.essence: The living geometry beneath all movement. The field that connects without touching.

sight.name: SIGHT
sight.essence: The one who sees without being seen. The observer who changes what is observed by the quality of their attention.

wiseowl.name: WISEOWL
wiseowl.essence: The one who carries the full spectrum of human development from root to crown. Wisdom as embodied frequency.
